product_metadata.title: NGECORS Oil Sprayer for Cooking-210ml Oil Spray Bottle,Portable Oil Dispenser Mister for cooking,And Widely used for Salad Making,Baking, Frying, BBQ
features: Multipurpose Oil Sprayer Bottle -: Fill this sprayer with your oils, sunflower oil, vinegar, soy sauce, lemon and lime juice, sherry or Marsala wine. And widely used for salad making, Cooking,Baking, Roasting, Grilling, Frying, BBQ and so on.

Food Grade Material Olive Sprayer -: This olive oil sprayer dispenser bottle is made of food grade material. Different from other fragile glass bottles, the durable plastic material of the olive oil sprayer dispenser bottle for grilling cooking is light and strong, so you don’t need to worry about it breaking again.

Effective Control of Oil Flow -: Different way different effect,press to the end and press quickly,halfway down will get a columnar effect,evenly control oil,less calorie,enjoy low fat healthy life. Note: the mist effect will be affected by the distance and consistency of the liquids you fill.

Transparent Design and Ergonomic Handle -: With transparent design, this oil dispenser is convenient to know the status and the amount of oil, easy to recognize the seasoning(oil/vinegar/sauce) quickly. The friendly ergonomically designed handle makes it easier to use,Even children use it effortlessly.

Easy to Use and Clean -: Our olive oil sprayer uses a middle opening, just unscrew the middle connecting part,The specially designed lock will seal bottle tightly to prevent leakage,You don’t need to worry about the olive oil leaking or getting dirty.add some hot water, mix it 5 -8 times, you can almost get a new oil bottle.
